product_metadata.title: Stock Your Home Eco Grocery Bags Disposable (200 Pack) Biodegradable T-Shirt Thank You Plastic Bag with Handles for Supermarket, Groceries, Produce, Shopping, Trash, Small Compostable Baggies Bulk
features: Proudly Made in the USA: Tested and proven in accordance with ASTM D5511 to biodegrade 49.28% in 900 days under landfill conditions compared to a regular plastic bag that can take approximately 30 years to decompose.
Eco-Friendly: Unlike traditional plastic bags, our green grocery bags are eco-friendly and biodegradable. This helps remove plastic from landfills, overall benefiting the environment.
Feels Like Plastic: A great sustainable choice, our eco friendly bags perform just as well as a comparable plastic shopping bag with handles. They even have the same heat/cold tolerance.

Multipurpose: You can use our bags for everyday shopping at your local supermarket. They're convenient for packing lunch or lining small trash cans. They're also great for cat litter and dog poop disposal.
Great Value Pack: Includes 200 green biodegradable bags. Measures 12” Width x 22”Length x 6.5” Gusset Width with 12.5 micron thickness. *Store in a cool area, away from direct sunlight.
